findings.title: Inverted lightness percentages in `.custom-message-length`
findings.body: In `app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss` line 102, `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The 30% and 70% values are swapped compared to the original rule and the matching desktop rule in `app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/modal.scss` line 94 (`dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`), making the custom message length counter much darker in light themes and much lighter in dark themes on mobile.
